shared_elements: wheeled vehicle / chariot with spoked wheel
carved relief scene arranged in horizontal registers
procession of figures moving in one direction
justification: Both show a horse-drawn conveyance with a spoked wheel accompanied by armed human figures in profile, with weapons and a directional procession, which is a fairly specific correspondence. But A is a single naturalistic narrative frieze of archers, horses and a chariot filling the whole panel, while B is a rounded stone divided into a small upper figural register above a large field entirely occupied by dense interlaced ribbon/serpent ornament, which has no counterpart in A.
